entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Recolour the FIRST reference painting only, preserving its exact composition, scene, architecture, figures, symbols, framing and small pixel clusters. SECOND reference is COLOUR ONLY: match the warm light YELLOW on its banners and robes, roughly straw/butter yellow with soft golden shadows. This is Cam's desired yellow: noticeably warmer and richer than cream or lemon ivory, but lighter than orange ochre. No sour green, pale lime, white wax, metallic gold or global colour filter. Neutral grey masonry, grey overcast sky and deep black recesses stay neutral. Retain N.C.Wyeth/Dean Cornwell narrative composition, broad value masses, environmental scale, one focal action, hard hand-placed pixel clusters, hard edges, selective dithering and limited palette. All human, dead and depicted faces remain ENTIRELY indiscernible at full size: back views and opaque hood voids, no eyes/nose/mouth/skull features. Non-graphic cosmic horror, no wounds or gore, no text, legible writing, new symbols, UI, frame or border. Keep existing Hollow Sun motif only. Opaque 5:7 portrait Practice Offering of Names. Preserve platform at y38%, heads22-27%, feet38-40%, every identifying object and person ends above43%. Complete ritual in upper central45%. Lower55% stays the same vast almost-black empty arch, no new light or clutter. Change robes, torn sun membrane and formerly ochre material to the SECOND reference's banner yellow; central shroud remains neutral. Accent: clear deep muted ROYAL PURPLE / dusty violet, plum shadows, around #68447c in lit fabric, not blue, pink or almost-black aubergine. Purple replaces only existing purple binding/trim/drapes, remains visible in broad shapes; yellow stays primary. No purple world tint.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine the supplied cult emblem for a tiny dark-fantasy game card. One isolated PALE IVORY symbol on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background and cutouts. Keep same basic identity; improve recognition at16/24px. Restrained flat bone shading and hard pixel-cluster edges, broad connected masses, thick strokes, very wide negative spaces. Reduce visual noise: no tiny scratches, scattered particles, thin cracks, realistic rendered stone or heavy bevels. No outer badge, border, text, letters, numbers, glow or faces. Fit within central80% of square. DEBT GRASP for Merchant. Retain ONE solid round coin in an asymmetric grasp. Simplify the three barbed talons to a broad C-shaped possessive hook and one shorter inward spur, forming ONE connected enclosing mass beneath and around the coin. The long right hook bends over the coin, the short left hook stops lower. Coin remains a separate solid disc; broad transparent crescent gap separates disc from grasp. Give the exterior a blunt rounded lower bowl and ONE dominant hook: no three equal upright/downward points, no crown, no eye, no hollow sun ring, no realistic hand, no symmetry, no additional coins. The result should look acquisitive and sinister, but its crooked round silhouette and filled coin distinguish it from a tall spear-crown, empty solar ring and broad book.

Make it a horizontal silhouette roughly1.6times wider than high, with a deep central V notch at top and clearly folded lower book edges. Remove BOTH lightning-shaped page holes: blank pale pages have only ONE short thick inset step near each outside edge, no writing. Replace the three hanging barbed roots with ONE thick central hooked spine hanging below, curling once to the right like a binding that has become a living captor. No three dangling rays, no trident, no crown. Keep one broad dark/transparent central spine seam between pages. Large open wings of the book must read at16px; one cruel hooked spine gives the cult twist at24px. Distinct from round Merchant grasp, hollow Priest sun and tall three-pronged Warlord crown.
